# Maniyarasan S. — Developer, CEO & Co-Founder

> Maniyarasan S. is a developer, Computer Science & Engineering student, and the CEO & Co-Founder of Problem Solving Mind (PSM) — a product-focused technology company based in Pondicherry, Tamil Nadu, India, working worldwide. This is his personal portfolio, which also documents the company he co-founded and the work it does.

Maniyarasan builds digital products, custom software, AI systems and automation. His portfolio covers product engineering (web and mobile applications), artificial intelligence, intelligent systems, hardware/IoT exploration, and technology-driven ventures through Problem Solving Mind.

## Company — Problem Solving Mind (PSM)

Problem Solving Mind (short: PSM) is a product-focused technology company building practical software, AI-powered solutions and connected systems for real-world problems. PSM builds its own technology products and also engineers custom software and integrations for organizations.

- Legal/trading name: Problem Solving Mind
- Short name: PSM
- Slogan / tagline: Building Products. Solving Problems.
- What it is: A product company — measured by products that ship, systems that keep working, and problems that stop being problems.
- Location: Pondicherry, Tamil Nadu, India — working worldwide
- Team size: 20+ people
- Founded: PSM began with the idea that technology should solve meaningful problems; it has since expanded from early software projects into building scalable products across multiple domains.
- Mission: Turn real-world problems into technology that creates opportunity.
- Vision: A global company that solves problems and creates livelihoods through innovation.
- Approach: "We don't start with technology. We start with the problem." (problem-first, practical technology, end-to-end, built to grow)
- Process (6 steps): Problems → Understand → Design → Build → Integrate → Scale
- Company website: https://www.problemsolvingmind.com
- Contact: hello@problemsolvingmind.com | contact@problemsolvingmind.com | founder@problemsolving.com | ceo@problemsolving.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 93602 07861
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/problem-solving-minds/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/problemsolvingmind

## Services (PSM capabilities)

- [Custom software development](https://www.problemsolvingmind.com/solutions/#business-software): Platforms, internal tools and enterprise systems.
- [AI & business automation](https://www.problemsolvingmind.com/solutions/#ai-automation): Automate workflows, data and decisions.
- [ERP & CRM integration](https://www.problemsolvingmind.com/solutions/#erp-crm): Connect existing tools into one ecosystem.
- [Web & mobile applications](https://www.problemsolvingmind.com/solutions/#web-mobile): Products for teams and customers.
- [Digital transformation](https://www.problemsolvingmind.com/solutions/#transformation): From paper-based to platform-driven workflows.

## Products (in development)

- [EYD — Explore Your Dreams](https://www.problemsolvingmind.com/eyd/): Real estate & construction; 3D property and home-building platform.
- [LECOM](https://www.problemsolvingmind.com/products/lecom/): Communication & learning — "Communication. Learning. Growth."
- [BOOWA](https://www.problemsolvingmind.com/products/boowa/): Hyperlocal delivery — "Local Delivery, On Your Schedule."
- [Aura](https://www.problemsolvingmind.com/products/aura/): Proactive healthcare companion.
